provenance.definition: Earth geocenter observes apparent Sun, light-time/aberration/deflection applied, true ecliptic and equinox of date, longitude multiple of 15 degrees.
provenance.timeScale: Search TT/TDB; output UTC via leap seconds. TT-UTC=69.184 s throughout 2026, IERS Bulletin C72.
provenance.accuracyCaution: Search precision is not absolute ephemeris/model accuracy. Full-vs-2000B is a sensitivity check, not an independent ephemeris.
